brief.aim: The table is the UCI Dry Bean dataset: 16 geometric morphometry features plus a 7-level categorical Class naming bean varieties, which is clearly the intended outcome, so this is multiclass classification. No identifier, grouping or chronology columns exist, and the geometry features are independent measurements rather than recodings of Class.
brief.repeated_subjects: None observed; each row is a distinct bean and columns have near-unique values per row.
brief.unit: One dry bean (grain) sample described by its shape/size morphometry
